name: Xochiquetzal
subtitle: Feather Blossom

lore: Goddess of love, beauty, and the arts, Xochiquetzal attempted to use her charms to entice the mortals and gods of other realms into following the ways of Omeyocan. When most reacted with horror—for Xochiquetzal is no less reliant on mass sacrifice than her brethren—she retreated home, a new and unfamiliar sense of resentment for outsiders now smoldering in her breast.
